# D2RLCompiler

This directory pins the compiler used to build Buff HUD's companion MPQ in CI and Release.

Expected binary:

```text
D2RLCompiler.exe
```

Package supplied for this project: `D2RLCompiler-1.0.0.zip`.

Expected SHA-256:

```text
8a2bfde3859a71927a7a58a84cca2a098f6c6ba760198a66177ee5d15f04709f  D2RLCompiler.exe
```

The supplied ZIP did not contain a separate license file or redistribution terms. Confirm redistribution permission before publishing the executable from a public repository.
